section.greek: Καὶ ταύτην οἱ πολλοὶ μὲν ὡϲ ὄψον ἐϲθίουϲιν, ἰατροὶ δ’ ὡϲ φαρμάκῳ ξηραίνοντι χρῶνται. λέλεκται δὲ περὶ αὐτῆϲ ἤδη μέν τινα κὰν ταῖϲ τῶν φαρμάκων δυνάμεϲι κὰν τῷ πρὸ τοῦδε γράμματι, καὶ νῦν δ’ ἐπὶ κεφαλαίων εἰρήϲεται, τὸν μὲν χυλὸν αὐτῆϲ ἔχειν τι καθαρτικόν, αὐτὸ δὲ τὸ ϲῶμα κατὰ τὸν τοῦ ξηραίνειν λόγον ἐπέχειν μᾶλλον ἢ προτρέπειν εἰϲ ὑποχώρηϲιν. ὅταν μὲν οὖν ἐκκρίνεϲθαι βουλώμεθα τὰ κατὰ τὴν γαϲτέρα, πληϲίον κειμένηϲ τῆϲ κακκάβηϲ, ἐν ἧπερ ἂν ἡψημένη τύχῃ, μετὰ τοῦ ὕδατοϲ ἀναϲπῶνταϲ αὐτὴν εὐθέωϲ ἐμβάλλειν χρὴ τοῖϲ ἀγγείοιϲ, ἐν οἷϲπερ ἐϲκεύαϲται τοὔλαιον ἅμα τῷ γάρῳ. διαφέρει δ’ οὐδὲν οὐδ’ εἰ δι’ ἁλῶν ἀντὶ γάρου λαμβάνοιτο.
section.english_working_translation: Most people eat this too as a relish, whereas physicians use it as a drying medicine. Some things about it have already been said both in the work on the powers of medicines and in the preceding book; now a summary will be given: its juice has something purgative, but the body itself, in virtue of drying, checks rather than encourages evacuation. Therefore, whenever we wish the contents of the belly to be discharged, with the pot in which it has been boiled close at hand, we should lift it out together with the water and immediately put it into the vessels in which oil with fish sauce has been prepared. Nor does it make any difference if it is taken with salt instead of fish sauce.
section.translation_status: Own source-side semantic translation; not a target reading or certified modern pharmacology.

source_ownership.native: The complete2.44 text was checked against the three institutional Greek print pages311–313. The chapter begins at the bottom of311 and ends before chapter45 on313. Adjacent entries visible on pages are not additional proposal units.
source_ownership.text_policy: All five Greek body paragraphs retained; whitespace collapsed, lunate sigma retained, editorial page bars removed. No heading is needed to establish opposing actions: all critical claims are in body text.
source_ownership.translation: Own working English translation of every paragraph, not a copy of the2003 English translation.
source_ownership.apparatus: Printed variant apparatus visible but not fully edited here. Grammatical variants and the editorial correction at313.1 do not license changing the selected body claims; no variant chosen for code convenience.
source_ownership.historical_truth: The object of this record is what the historical author says, not clinical efficacy or modern chemical truth.

uncertainties_and_no_invention: No exact water amount, juice amount, temperature, boiling duration, loss rate or composition balance is given. Numerical mass conservation is not licensed.
The evacuation branch transfers cabbage together with water, but does not say all the water.
The drying branch discards first water and boils in other hot water; this entry does not explicitly instruct discarding the second water before eating. Do not silently add that step.
Air-contact prohibition is written literally alongside cold water. Its practical extent and physical truth are unresolved; it must not be silently rewritten as simply avoiding cooling.
The air/cold-water countercase explicitly predicts failure to soften. It does not separately state the gut effect after that failure; do not invent an additional clinical branch.
The eye exception does not explicitly assert improved vision. The urinary statement is an epistemic limitation, not proven zero effect.
Juice terminology is used for the plant’s own juice and in nutritional humor assessment. No exact modern chemical fraction identity is claimed.
Earlier works/the preceding book are explicitly referenced but not treated as entirely included in this unit. Section3 restates the local transfer dependency.
The contemporary referent of rhaphanos is unnamed here; do not insert a modern species. The600-year contrast is reported authorial speech.
No Voynich anchor or complete writer is provided. Finite grammar, paragraph scope, operator realization and unknown lexical content remain unbound. No source-clause-to-target-word count is assumed.

source_choice_before_target: II.44.1 selected overII.44.2 because it adds food-versus-medicine use, explicit two-work backward citation, juice-versus-solid-body opposition, evacuation-serving transfer retaining some cooking water, and fish-sauce/salt substitution. No new source or recipe variant. Neither subsequent target difficulty nor old496 grammar will trigger a switch toII.44.2.
source_obligations: Most people eat C as relish, while physicians use it as drying medicine.
The author refers to earlier discussion both in the work on powers of medicines and in the preceding book, then offers a summary now; referenced works are not included as new source units.
Intrinsic juice J(C) has a purgative property, while C’s solid body checks rather than encourages evacuation by its drying action. This is not the old keedy=human recipient BODY.

Under the intention of evacuation, the boiling pot must be close, C is lifted together with cooking water and immediately put into vessels where oil and fish sauce are prepared. Not all cooking water is asserted to transfer.
Taking it with salt instead of fish sauce makes no difference in the source’s local intended preparation/use; do not invent global equivalence of salt and fish sauce.

frozen_parent_lexicon.denotation: The two specified foods have similar drying action. This compound does not supply their identities, the sight consequence or the exception.

Dulling of the specified faculty, here sight; no additional harm or numerical degree.
Same directed relation at4 and31: dulling targets sight; nourishment is supplied to the body. No change to a causal connector at31.
Human visual faculty, distinct from a physical eye and from nourishment.
The guard removes the otherwise stated consequence from the claim’s scope; it does not assert the opposite effect when the guard holds.
The entire relevant eye; not the whole human body or just an unspecified wet surface.
The following moisture is beyond the relevant natural condition. No quantitative threshold is given.
Copular application; identical denotation at9,34,38. It does not select a new subject or change the property.

The lentil/lentil-soup food type in the owned working source. This is a guessed name; it does not identify a depicted botanical specimen.

Exact freely guessed synonym of saiiin.

Exact freely guessed synonym of sshey. It negates good-juicedness at36 and the stated disjunction of reportability propositions at47.

The food has good intrinsic juice. This adjective presupposes a juice profile J(food); negation denies its GOOD quality, not the existence of juice. That internal constituent projection is an explicit cost.
Bad quality of the bound entity/profile; main C04 applies it to J(C). The lexical predicate alone does not determine owner or exclude application to a whole food.

The author can state a manifest result of the specified kind. Under NOT this is lack of warranted reportability, not proof of no physical effect and not an inability of every observer to know anything.

A manifest harmful urinary consequence from the same bound food. This is a second compound descriptor, not an actual adverse event.

unbound_target_ranges.pressure: Four separate concerns begin here: CAUSES7/16 literally retain the parent drying-to-sight cause claim, BOTH_FOODS9 is C/L, and UNNATURALLY8/13 must retain their qualitative modifier meaning. The only written MOIST19 could potentially be shared by two explicit resumed conditions, but no complete grammar for that is supplied. VEGETABLE11 still denotes C. Do not turn UNNATURALLY into a preparation intensity or BOTH_FOODS into juice/body.

CAN_STATE_MANIFEST27/40 retains source-author reportability, not now-summarize, physical efficacy or patient capability. SOLID_FOOD28 IS29 NOT30 can support an old not-solid-food recap with C, but the whole clause and neighboring CAUSES32 are not bound. NOT35 and OF36 need actual scope and a food-owner. LENTIL39 is the old food L. ALL41 quantifies a human-group restriction under the501 contract; it cannot quantify foods or recipe ingredients.

CAUSES47 again keeps the sight-specific parent claim, THIS_FOOD49 is C, NOT50 needs a scope, TO51 a directed output/recipient and EFFECT54/58 food/domain arguments. GOOD_JUICED56 cannot be simply asserted of C because parent499 explicitly denies good intrinsic juice for C. A coherent negative recap remains possible, but no full bracketing was completed. CABBAGE62 is the same C. Cooking water, intrinsic juice, solid body and human recipient must remain distinct.

known_countercases_and_serious_alternati: An attempted generic lchedy=CAUSES interpretation would lose four repetitions of the literal parent drying-to-sight content; it is not a fixed-value extension.
Positive unqualified GOOD_JUICED(C) conflicts with parent499’s source4 assertion. A negative scope or old-T reference is an allowed possible construction, not proof that this paragraph is impossible.

A complete new dictionary for all35 unknown forms could still be explored under the same fixed source and target in a separately authorized descendant. This bounded producer has not proved an impossibility theorem or exhausted all grammars.

Source1 can coherently coexist with source4: bad intrinsic juice and a purgative property are distinct axes; drying-related checks by solid body and food-as-medicine use do not prove one net clinical outcome. No contradiction is inferred merely because attributes differ.

The strongest remaining alternative is that this whole paragraph is another source4-heavy explanatory recap plus source1 content under a more explicit construction. Four sight-cause repetitions make it costly, but no unchanged-capacity test establishes its impossibility.
The completed parent501 remains conditional on its old reportability aside and TO/OF typed embeddings; no new fragment repairs or validates it.
